/*selectBuyerMpSoUniformStockList*/
SELECT (SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = A.BUYER) AS BUYER_NAME, A.BUYER, A.BUYER_ITEM_NO, MAX(B.DESCRIPTION_LOC) AS DESCRIPTION, MAX(B.SPECIFICATION) AS SPECIFICATION, SUM(A.RQ_QTY) AS REQ_QTY, SUM(A.GR_QTY) AS GR_QTY, SUM(A.CHUL_QTY) AS CHUL_QTY, SUM(A.RTN_QTY) AS RTN_QTY, SUM(A.GR_QTY) - SUM(A.CHUL_QTY) + SUM(A.RTN_QTY) AS STOCK_QTY FROM KEP_BUYER_ST_MNG A, ICOMBYIT B, ICOMCMPY C WHERE A.BUYER = C.COM_CODE AND C.BYCA_COMORG_CODE = B.BUYER AND B.BUYER_ITEM_NO = A.BUYER_ITEM_NO AND A.BUYER IN (SELECT COMPANY_CODE FROM ICOMCOD2 WHERE TYPE = 'ST01' AND CODE = #{st_user_id} AND TEXT2 = #{st_com_code} AND FLAG = 'Y')
AND A.BUYER = #{st_buyer}
AND B.BUYER_ITEM_NO LIKE '%' || #{st_buyer_item_no} || '%'
AND B.DESCRIPTION_LOC LIKE '%' || #{st_description} || '%'
AND B.SPECIFICATION LIKE '%' || #{st_specification} || '%'
GROUP BY A.BUYER,A.BUYER_ITEM_NO
